finding.title: Classifying all market views as ordinary detail loses the parent context for directly navigated root market pages
actualPath: Use a lawful qi+ character at market. Open goal item-source detail and choose go-purchase-herb (or any actual purchase source).
navigate selects the target tab, clears detailParent, then directly sets hubView=market. It does not call openHub(market).
Edit the chosen root-market order, then open HUD goal or character detail; close it.
finding.cause: detailViews now contains market. openHub only captures a new detailParent when current hubView is not in detailViews. The direct navigate route leaves market with detailParent=null, so opening another detail still leaves null. closeHub therefore calls selectTab(修行) and returns home instead of this market view.
finding.beforeAfter: Previously market was not in detailViews, so opening goal/character from a directly navigated market captured {view:market,tab:历练}. The new classification fixes bag->sale->close but regresses this existing source-navigation path. Nested Explore->purchase keeps hubView=explore and is unaffected.
finding.impact: No automatic transaction or resource change; breaks current ordinary-details return contract and sends the user away from the chosen draft context. The local cached draft may persist but is no longer reached by closing the detail.
finding.neededRed: Actual source go-purchase-* -> root market -> nondefault complete order -> goal/character -> close must show same market and all fields unchanged; also retain the new bag->sale->close case. Include a real6s travel variant separately if caller starts elsewhere.
finding.repairBoundary: Distinguish a directly entered market from a market inspection with an existing ordinary-detail parent, or consistently establish that parent at direct entry. Avoid a new arbitrary multi-level navigation stack; do not alter travel/start/Store identities.
